framing.text: You step up to the register with your basket. The clerk looks up.
The clerk holds up your bento, gesturing toward the microwave.
Next, the clerk nods toward a stack of plastic bags by the register.
The clerk taps the little card reader mounted on the counter.
The register beeps and displays your total.
The clerk counts out your change, note by note.
You gather your bags. The clerk gives a small bow.
The automatic door slides open behind you.
